{"items":[{"ref":"R06","coverage_id":"3c57d1bfeec301a5061a3aac","coverage_title":"选择时段页：核对信息入口","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"任务及下一步目的明确，完整选择页提供“核对信息”按钮及两个时段；检查名称与邻近说明。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-ed5981943d36420abcbcfb932f3a6a84"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["选择时段页／核对信息"],"object_ids":["obj-d18c45035f1cf481864b"],"constraint_refs":["REQ1"],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]},{"ref":"R06","coverage_id":"d26ef33e7cf79b4071dfdc34","coverage_title":"核对页：返回选择与提交登记入口","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"核对页主要操作及任务目的明确；分别核对返回、提交名称与上下文，不以按钮可见推定提交成功。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["核对信息页／返回选择","核对信息页／提交登记"],"object_ids":["obj-2ba5c91c54257c9ca213","obj-96d6f72e97ca58664da8"],"constraint_refs":["REQ2","REQ3"],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]},{"ref":"R06","coverage_id":"coverage-174d74576132ebc4","coverage_title":"BR3：完成页重新开始入口","task_id":"TASK2","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"任务卡说明完成页可重新开始，但尚无完成页观察，需取得实际按钮及邻近内容后检查命名。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a"],"evidence_needed":["完成页完整画面及重新开始入口原文"],"object_refs":["BR3／完成页重新开始入口（待观察）"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ4"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R07","coverage_id":"cb2c03e46e454322f59c5ca9","coverage_title":"选择时段页：下午选中状态的选项名称","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"时段单选项承担登记信息输入；检查两项名称及服务台说明，并对照切换前后必要线索是否保留。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-ed5981943d36420abcbcfb932f3a6a84","ev-7a09dc68a4fd47958ab10ea4889fb401"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["周五09:00–09:30／一层服务台","周五14:00–14:30／二层服务台"],"object_ids":["obj-92075c3425890f97081d"],"constraint_refs":["REQ1"],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]},{"ref":"R07","coverage_id":"d26ef33e7cf79b4071dfdc34","coverage_title":"核对页：信息展示区域","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"完整核对页为日期、时段和服务台的只读展示，控件为返回及提交按钮，没有待填写字段。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["核对信息页／只读信息区域"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]},{"ref":"R08","coverage_id":"cb2c03e46e454322f59c5ca9","coverage_title":"选择时段页：页面容器性质","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"完整画面与页面结构显示常规第一步页面，中央卡片是页面内容而非占据焦点的普通弹窗。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-7a09dc68a4fd47958ab10ea4889fb401"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["选择时段页／主内容卡片"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]},{"ref":"R08","coverage_id":"d26ef33e7cf79b4071dfdc34","coverage_title":"核对页：页面容器性质","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"完整画面呈现第2步核对页面，结合选择至核对的转换记录，当前对象是流程页面而非普通弹窗。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-54c27ab204c6479384eced085b8c3114","ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["核对信息页／主内容卡片"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]},{"ref":"R09","coverage_id":"cb2c03e46e454322f59c5ca9","coverage_title":"选择时段页：第一步导航","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"画面明确标示“第1步，共3步”，属于首步，不满足非首步页面的适用条件。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-7a09dc68a4fd47958ab10ea4889fb401"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["选择时段页／步骤标识"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]},{"ref":"R09","coverage_id":"d26ef33e7cf79b4071dfdc34","coverage_title":"核对页：非首步返回入口","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"页面明确为第2步，登记仅当前页面生效；检查可见返回入口。浏览器导航不在截图范围，保留状态另由REQ2检查。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab","ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["核对信息页／返回选择"],"object_ids":["obj-2ba5c91c54257c9ca213"],"constraint_refs":["REQ2"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R09","coverage_id":"coverage-174d74576132ebc4","coverage_title":"BR3：完成页导航与复位入口","task_id":"TASK2","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"完成页尚未呈现，需确认其步骤性质和可见导航；任务卡所述重新开始不能替代页面观察。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a"],"evidence_needed":["完成页完整画面及可见导航"],"object_refs":["BR3／完成页导航（待观察）"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ4"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R10","coverage_id":"d26ef33e7cf79b4071dfdc34","coverage_title":"核对页：登记操作风险性质","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"任务卡明确登记仅在本机当前页面生效且可以复位；当前为普通登记核对，不是删除、永久变更等高风险确认。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["核对信息页／提交登记"],"object_ids":["obj-96d6f72e97ca58664da8"],"constraint_refs":["REQ4"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R11","coverage_id":"d26ef33e7cf79b4071dfdc34","coverage_title":"核对页：动作入口同一性","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"当前页的返回选择与提交登记是不同动作，各只有一个入口；重复捕获同一按钮不构成两个独立入口。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-54c27ab204c6479384eced085b8c3114","ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["核对信息页／返回选择","核对信息页／提交登记"],"object_ids":["obj-2ba5c91c54257c9ca213","obj-96d6f72e97ca58664da8"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]},{"ref":"R11","coverage_id":"cb2c03e46e454322f59c5ca9","coverage_title":"选择时段页：核对动作入口同一性","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"完整选择页只有一个“核对信息”入口；选项切换及返回后仍是同一入口，不满足至少两个同动作入口的条件。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-7a09dc68a4fd47958ab10ea4889fb401","ev-4a119973f66c4bb5823812d82b6658dd"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["选择时段页／核对信息"],"object_ids":["obj-d18c45035f1cf481864b"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]}]}
